hooks.name: Property tests for pure logic
hooks.description: After the agent edits a file, reminds it to keep src/lib covered by property-based tests and to route third-party HTML through the sanitizer.

action.prompt: If the file you just changed is in src/lib/ (and is not a test), make sure its behavior is covered by fast-check properties in the matching *.test.ts file, using a seeded Rng for any randomness. If you changed a rule from .kiro/specs/grimoire/requirements.md, update the property table in design.md too. If the file is in src/components/ and renders HTML from Wikipedia, confirm it goes through prepareArticle().
